question: What would a prolonged total closure of Hormuz cut from global oil supply?
answer: With the strait open, tankers pass and the world gets all its oil. A big share of the world's oil sails through this one narrow strait, so a long block would stop 15–20% of global supply from reaching buyers. Brent has already hit almost $94 a barrel, up 8%.
move: One strait carries up to a fifth of the world's oil.
